findings.evidence: R15Contracts.CloseTicketRequest declares reason and expectedVersion without @NotNull at lines 91-94, but R15Service.closeTicket builds the idempotency intent with Map.of at lines 311-313 using clean(request.reason()) and request.expectedVersion(). Java Map.of rejects null values, so a contract-valid close request that omits either optional field throws NullPointerException before returning the required business/error-code response. The same pattern exists for AssignTicketRequest.reason: optional at R15Contracts.java:86-89, consumed by Map.of at R15Service.java:266-268.
findings.issue: Optional request fields accepted by the contract can produce raw 500/NPE before idempotency/error-code handling.
findings.requirement_ref: TASK-R15-003 acceptance: 权限/幂等/错误码/审计覆盖; OpenAPI契约测试

findings.evidence: R15PostgresStore.announcements builds queries over hhy.announcements as alias announcement at lines 46-57, but reuses notificationWhere. notificationWhere appends announcement.read_at predicates for status READ/UNREAD at lines 465-467. The announcements SQL only synthesizes NULL as the selected read_at value; it does not define an announcement.read_at table column, so those accepted query values lead to a database error instead of a contract response.
findings.issue: Announcement list status filtering can generate invalid SQL for READ/UNREAD and return a database error.
